## Fixes

1. [A2, Test 2] When the exam date is blank, still date every Study Plan entry by calendar week starting from the current week (e.g. "Oct 4–10"), not just "Week 1", "Week 2".
2. [A1, Test 2] Never copy a multi-week syllabus range such as "Week 3-4" as one entry; split its topics across separate one-week entries (here respiration Oct 18–24, photosynthesis Oct 25–31), and shift later topics accordingly (DNA in Nov 1–7).
3. [A5, Test 2] Do not write any note in the Practice Questions section explaining which topics or functions the questions avoid; just give the five questions.

FIX AND RETEST — send the Fixes and your current recipe to the Builder, install the new version, then run all three tests again.
